{{Quote|For over a thousand generations the Jedi Knights were the guardians of peace and justice in the Old Republic. Before the dark times. Before the Empire.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="EPIV" />}}
The '''Jedi Order''', later known as the '''Old Jedi Order''' and referred to as the '''Holy Order of the Jedi Knights''', was an ancient monastic peacekeeping organization unified by its belief and observance of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], specifically the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were the guardians of peace and justice in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and became perhaps the most well known of the various groups that relied on the Force for their power. Led by a series of [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]], the Order grew over the millennia despite facing many trials. Most often these threats were engineered by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the most prominent group of Force sensitives who wielded the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

During several [[Great Schism/Legends|Great Schisms]], numerous Jedi broke away from the original Order due to differences in how they believed the Force should be wielded. The various impasses reached by the orthodox Jedi and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|defectors]] led to several wars, including the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], after which [[Exiles|the defectors]] were exiled and founded the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. The Sith were eventually found by the Republic and their discovery led to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], and a Sith [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Hyperspace War)|invasion of Coruscant]]. The Jedi on Coruscant, led by [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] [[Anavus Svag]] and Jedi Master [[Memit Nadill]], successfully defended the planet and defeated the Sith. Again and again however, the Sith would be reborn from within the ranks of the Jedi Order, and many more wars would be fought. Additionally, the ancient Sith Empire had not been as completely destroyed as the Jedi believed and over the next thousand years, it reformed and grew.

A thousand years later, after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the Sith Empire manipulated the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] into [[Mandalorian Wars|attacking]] the indolent Republic. The Jedi Council forbade the Order's members from participating in the following war, but two Jedi, [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]], garnered the support of many of their peers and entered the war on the side of the Republic. Prevailing after a long and bloody conflict, Revan and the Jedi who had followed him disappeared after the war's final battle. When they returned, they had turned to the dark side, and during the [[Jedi Civil War|war]] that followed most of the Jedi Order was either destroyed or seduced by Revan's teachings. During the [[First Jedi Purge|aftermath]] the Order was left numbering less than one-hundred Jedi. In light of this, the remaining members of the Jedi Council officially disbanded the Order. Shortly thereafter, nearly all the remaining Jedi were consumed by [[Darth Nihilus]] when they [[Conclave at Katarr|convened]] on Katar. However, the exiled Jedi Knight [[Meetra Surik]] defeated the [[Sith Triumvirate]] of Darths Nihilus, Sion, and Traya, and reformed the Order with the help of the [[Lost Jedi]].

About three hundred years after the Jedi Civil War, the ancient Sith Empire had again become strong enough to directly challenge the Jedi and the Republic for control over the galaxy. The initial onslaught of the Sith Empire saw over half of the Republic's territory fall into Sith hands, but the Republic managed to check the Sith's advance in the Mid-Rim. After a time, the Sith Empire surprised the galaxy by offering a truce, which was accepted by the Republic. However, the Sith used the lull in the war to launch a [[Sacking of Coruscant|surprise attack]] on Coruscant. The capture of the Republic capital allowed the Sith to extort many concessions from the Republic, and the resulting [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was slanted heavily in the Empire's favor. This began the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which lasted for about twelve years. Afterwards, the conflict began anew, and the Republic would eventually emerge victorious.

Centuries later, the galaxy was again engulfed in a [[New Sith Wars|war]] between the Republic and the Sith. Led by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]], the Jedi were able to regroup and push back the Sith, who eventually withdrew to the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. After seven long battles on Ruusan, the Sith were [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|defeated]] and presumed wiped out. [[Darth Bane/Legends|One of them]] managed to survive and [[Rule of Two/Legends|reorganize]] the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Sith Order]]. Though [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] that [[Order of the Sith Lords|followed]] in his footsteps remained hidden, they were patient. Millennia later, they [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|revealed themselves]], determined to have their revenge.

At the height of a [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|separatist crisis]], the Republic was split in two and a [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] once again engulfed the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, the Republic's armies were once again led by the Jedi. During the war's first [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]], nearly two hundred Jedi died before Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone army]] arrived to assist them. After nearly three years, the course of the war swung in the Republic's favor, and total victory for the Jedi and the Republic seemed in sight. However, the war itself was simply the penultimate stroke of the Sith [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]], orchestrated by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who was in fact a Sith Master. The Jedi eventually learned the truth, but could not stop the plan's execution; Palpatine convinced [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to betray the Jedi and join the dark side, allowing him to instigate the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The Order was virtually [[Order 66/Legends|annihilated]] by the Sith and betrayed by the Republic they had served for nearly all of its existence. Only a few survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. However, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], with the indirect help of his son, Jedi Knight [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], eventually [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeated]] the Sith, and Luke formed the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[New Republic era|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History of the Jedi Order==
===Tython and Force Wars===
{{Main|Je'daii Order|Force Wars}}
Many ancient and semi-legendary organizations have been proposed to be the forerunners of the Jedi Order, including the [[Order of Dai Bendu]],<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> the [[Followers of Palawa]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> and the [[Chatos Academy]].<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /> Of all of the ancient Force traditions, though, the true origin of the Order was found on the lush planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. The galaxy's best philosophers, priests, scientists, and warriors were brought to Tython circa [[36,453 BBY]] by mysterious, pyramidal ships called [[Tho Yor]] to discuss their discoveries involving the enigmatic and mystical energy known as [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. These people, known as [[Tythan]]s, eventually came to identify as the [[Je'daii Order]], a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] determined to keep an internal balance between the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side of the Force]], which they called Ashla, and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]], which they called Bogan.<ref name="DotJ0" />

[[File:Force_wars_JMGD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Force Wars]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].]]
For millennia the Je'daii Order flourished on Tython, erecting great temples and monuments to the Force and remaining ever vigilant to the lures of both the light and the dark.<ref name="DotJ0" /> Ultimately around [[25,793 BBY]], several hundred years before the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="History">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Galactic History}}</ref> a conflict arose between the followers of Ashla, who sought knowledge, and the followers of Bogan who wanted to gain power. Known as the [[Force Wars]], the conflict took a terrible toll on the planet.<ref>[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural]]</ref> In the end, the followers of Bogan were defeated. The followers of Ashla formed a new organization called the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> Among those first Jedi were [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Rajivari]], [[Garon Jard]], [[Cala Brin]] and [[Ters Sendon]], who helped formulate the tenets of the Order.<ref name="TOR Path of a Jedi" /> Rajivari and Jard were known to organize week-longs gatherings, the earliest form of [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], with many of their peers, to reflect on how to protect the Order from the dark side and to increase the Order's wisdom.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

During the Jedi's earliest days, Rajivari broke away and encouraged his followers to abandon Ashla and look to Bogan for guidance and power. Later, Rajivari [[Rajivari's purges|tried to murder]] his fellow Jedi and rebuild the Order based on [[Principles of Rajivari|his ideals]], but was killed during the attempt. His followers barricaded themselves in the fortress of Kaleth but were soon [[Siege of Kaleth|wiped out]] by the Order. Following their victory, the Jedi Order decided to abandon Tython, taking with them all surviving text and scriptures they could find.<ref name="SWTOR" />

===Early interactions with the Republic===
{{Main|First Great Schism|Tionese War}}
{{Quote|You must remember that there are over a hundred thousand inhabited worlds in the Republic, and there are now only a few thousand of us. ''Billions'' of beings have never seen a Jedi. Millions have never even heard of our Order. Or of the Force. When we do appear, we can be killers, but also healers. Thank the Force for that.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Republic55">[[Republic 55|''Republic'' 55]]</ref>}}
[[File:Jedi_Order.svg|thumb|130px|The former symbol of the Jedi, before being replaced with later symbols.]]
Traveling between the stars, the fledgling Jedi Order fled the Deep Core in favor of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], a wide swath of the galaxy which had yet to be explored. Discovering a verdant planet much like Tython had once been, the Jedi colonized the world and named it [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Founding an [[academy]] on the world, the Jedi Order remained in seclusion on Ossus, devoting their time to the study of the Ashla and warning against the evils of Bogan. Having purposely distanced themselves from the newly-formed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Jedi Order welcomed members of other Force traditions to Ossus, merging their philosophies and assimilating many other groups into their fold.<ref name="TEGTW" /> Carrying over traditions from the old Je'daii Forge, the Great Temple of [[Vur Tepe]],<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> the Jedi continued to craft [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] blades as part of initiation ceremonies and [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|imbue them]] with the Force. While these Force-imbued blades were the primary weapon of choice,<ref name="TEGTW" /> the Jedi continued to work to enhance the usability of a new weapon called the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. In the Order's final years on Tython, a [[Tau (individual)|mysterious man]] from beyond the system brought technology called a [[Forcesaber]] to the world. Through the study of the weapon, basically advanced off-world [[Laser/Legends|laser]] technology, the Jedi were able to "freeze" a laser beam.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /><ref name="DotJ0" /> In [[24,953 BBY]], the Jedi agreed to join the Republic,<ref name="T17">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Galactic History: The Jedi Join the Republic}}</ref> remaining isolated on Ossus but supporting the Republic's goal of galactic peace.<ref name="TEGTW" />

As the Order welcomed others to Ossus, the leaders of the Jedi began to be influenced by other thinkers who had been involved in galactic affairs much longer than they had. The most prominent influence was a group of [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] who preached<ref name="TEGTW" /> the principles of justice laid forth by [[Hespecia Tik'kla]]; these teachings would lay the framework for the Jedi Order's view of galactic justice and their role as peacekeepers.<ref name="TJP" /> At the same time, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] began to assert its authority over the members of the Order, limiting individuality and crafting several exclusionary regulations. Around this time a [[Kashi Mer Dynasty|Kashi Mer]] exile named [[Xendor]], who showed great interest in the Bogan, gained a large following on Ossus, taking counsel from a [[Followers of Palawa|Steel Hand of Palawa]] named [[Arden Lyn]] and eventually breaking from the Order to found his own [[Legionnaire Academy|academy]] on [[Lettow]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> Members of the so called [[Legions of Lettow]] celebrated their freedom by giving in to their emotions and passions, rejected the concepts of order and structure, and touched the power of the dark side. The outflow of students was deemed the [[First Great Schism|Great Schism]]. In [[24,500 BBY]], an open war erupted between the Legions and the Jedi Order.<ref name=":0">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Sources are divided on which side started the conflict,<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 13: The First Great Schism}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> some say it was the Jedi Order who declared war against the Legions and rose an army first,<ref name=":0" /><ref name="TEGTW" /> others say it was Xendor who attacked the Jedi.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 13: The First Great Schism}}</ref> The war began with the [[Battle of Ossus (First Great Schism)|Battle of Ossus]] before the Legions driven into the core. Xendor attempted to warn the Republic about the Jedi throughout the Republic about the Jedi as the war broke out, trying to convince the leaders that the Jedi were trying to seize power under the guise of peacekeepers. The Republic didn't believe Xendor's attempts to discredit the strange monks from Ossus and so began aiding the Jedi in the war effort. As conflict erupted on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]], [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself, the war dragged on and on. Finally, Jedi Master [[Awdrysta Pina]] managed to confront Xendor at the [[Battle of Columus|battle]] of [[Columus/Legends|Columus]] and slay the leader of the Legions, using a powerful [[Force-meld|battle meld]], a practice rejected by the Legionaries, since they saw it as giving up their individuality. In the following months, the rest of the Legions of Lettow were routed and the Great Schism finally ended.<ref name="TEGTW" />

Despite their brief allegiance with the Republic during the Great Schism, the Order was seldom thought of in the greater galaxy since their abandonment of Tython. Because of this the Order's warnings of impending war went unheeded by the Republic government until the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] were on their doorstep. As the [[Tionese War]] erupted across the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the Order's attempts to divide Tionese allegiances were abandoned and the Jedi withdrew again to Ossus to avoid involvement in the war. From their ancient fortress world, the Jedi contemplated the war, struggling to see how they fit into the galactic crisis at hand. After a long internal debate, the Jedi High Council declared for the Republic and entered into service as [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] in the [[Republic Army]] to crush the Tionese threat. As the war was all but won, the Republic sterilized the planet [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] in an event which horrified the Order. Meeting above the ruined world, the Jedi struck a deal with the Republic that, while they could not serve the government, they would establish a network of [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|watchmen]] to protect the Perlemian from the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] from a series of [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress worlds]] including Ossus, [[Falang Minor]],<ref name="TEGTW" /> and [[Haashimut]].<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /> When the war with the Tionese had been resolved, the Republic decided to disband its military and rely on sector- and system-based defense fleets, earning back the trust and allegiance of the Jedi Order.<ref name="TEGTW" />

===The beginning of the Sith===
{{Main|Pius Dea Crusades|Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends}}
In [[11,987 BBY]] Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pers'lya]] was assassinated and replaced by Chancellor [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]], a member of the [[Pius Dea]] faith. During his reign, the fanatical Chancellor began a series of [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] which would come in the form of war, purges, and genocide. Officially known as the Recusal, the Jedi Order declared itself independent from the Republic in [[11,933 BBY]] and completely withdrew back to Ossus. Throughout the next millennium, the Jedi Order fought an internal struggle regarding the correct response to the insanity of the [[Contispex dynasty]] and the Pius Dea rule it had established. While the majority of the Order refused to fight against the very government it had protected for millennia, some Jedi served as Knights errant, taking the fight to the cultists without the permission of the High Council. Others declared for the Pius Dea, forming a splinter group called the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]]. It wasn't until the [[11,100 BBY|11,100s BBY]] that the Order was approached by the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] and were finally convinced to end their period of isolationism and intervene. The Jedi High Council joined with the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] in seeding the [[cathedral ship]]s of the Pius Dea with a crippling virus, and plotting to arrest the current Chancellor. In a stunning move, a Jedi strike team boarded Chancellor [[Contispex XIX]]'s flagship, the ''[[Flame of Sinthara]]'' and arrested him on war crime charges. In accordance to the terms set forth by the Jedi Order at the start of their involvement, the Jedi High Council suspended the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and placed [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Biel Ductavis]] in the position of Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="TEGTW" />

[[File:Battle_of_Corbos_JMGD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]].]]
A few generations later, the Jedi Order had returned to their peaceful ways on Ossus upon seeing the Republic make a full recovery from the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> However, in [[7003 BBY]], the Jedi suffered a [[Second Great Schism]], resulting in a time known to history as the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. The schism stemmed from the Order's reaction to a group of heretical [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] experimenting with forbidden [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]], twisting living beings into monstrosities. The creatures which arose were deemed abominations to the Force by the High Council and war was begun to end the practice of these dark arts. By this time the Order had managed to develop the lightsaber in a way in which it was useful in hand-to-hand combat. Used before as a siege weapon due to its massive power pack, the Order's scientists were able to create a transportable power pack which could be worn on the belt of the user. Crossing blades with the heretics, who rose an army of animalistic monsters against them, the Jedi Order finally saw the end of the conflict with the victory at the [[Battle of Corbos|battle]] of [[Corbos]] in [[6900 BBY]].<ref name=":0" /> There the Jedi Order arrested the twelve surviving Dark Jedi, led by [[High General]] [[Ajunta Pall]], and banished them beyond the known galaxy. Unknown to the Jedi, these [[Exiles]] would land on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], homeworld of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], and posing as god-like beings, conquer the natives, deeming themselves the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]].<ref name="BoS" /> Shortly after settling on Korriban, a splinter group of exiles, led by [[Remulus Dreypa]], [[First battle between Jedi and Sith|returned to Republic space]] to enact vengeance, but were intercepted by a Jedi patrol. The Jedi pursued those Sith across the galaxy, until both factions crash-landed on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. After a period of fighting, the two factions made peace and formed a new organization called [[the Doomed]], striving to achieve balance between the light and the dark sides of the Force.<ref name="Lost Tribe">''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral]]''</ref> With their capital on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Sith Lords would form the massive [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], an Order of dark side warriors who would dream of revenge on the Jedi.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

===The Great Hyperspace War and aftermath===
{{Main|Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Freedon Nadd Uprising|Third Great Schism}}
{{Quote|The Republic has grown and expanded for many generations, encountering no worse than a few interplanetary squabbles and civil wars&hellip;but if we should confront the fabled Sith Empire, we will experience a war so great, so devastating&hellip;it can cross the fabric of hyperspace, a conflagration spanning the Galaxy&hellip;|Ooroo|<ref name="TFotSE1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:CoruscantGreatHyperspaceWar-JediVsSith.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Coruscant]] during the Great Hyperspace War.]]

In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] an attack on the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] by the Sith Empire introduced the Republic and the Jedi Order to the Sith and sparked the beginning of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. The battle began shortly after a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] named [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] had a nightmarish [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the death of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]], and the war against the Republic that it would cause. He traveled to Coruscant with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Memit Nadill]] and [[Teta/Legends|Teta]], the [[Emperor/Legends|empress]] of [[Koros]], to voice his concerns in front of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], though they did not take him seriously, and took no action.<ref name="TOTJ:GAOTS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref> Returning to Koros, Jedi Nadill, Odan-Urr and Urr's master [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]] were present when a young convict named [[Jori Daragon]] burst into Teta's chambers, telling the Jedi that she had seen the great Sith Empire, and that they were on their way to attack the Republic. Nadill learned as much as he could about the Sith Empire, then traveled to Coruscant to rally the support of the Jedi Knights.<ref name="TOTJ:FOTSE">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]''</ref>

The newly christened Dark Lord of the Sith, [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], deployed his fleets to invade numerous Republic worlds simultaneously while he left his eye-shaped [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] near [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]] and used Sith magic to create thousands of illusory soldiers, which made the Sith army seem far larger than it actually was. The Jedi Order played a huge role in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Hyperspace War)|defense]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], with Memit Nadill leading a team of Jedi Knights, including [[Tuknatan]] and [[Sonam-Ha'ar]]. Meanwhile, another battle was raging on the planet of [[Kirrek]], where Jedi Master Ooroo and his apprentice Odan-Urr were stationed. However, when Naga Sadow's concentration was broken, the illusory Sith forces disappeared and the Republic's forces' morale was bolstered. On Coruscant, the Jedi realized what had happened and launched a massive counterattack, easily defeating the Sith. The Republic also emerged victorious on Kirrek, however only at the expense of the death of Master Ooroo, who sacrificed his life in defeating a large force of Massassi warriors.<ref name="TOTJ:FOTSE" /> With the Sith forces routed, Supreme Chancellor [[Pultimo]] ordered the complete [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|invasion]] of [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGTW" /> liberating the Sith from the Dark Lords<ref name="GH30">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 30: Rise of the Sith Emperor}}</ref> and ultimately dissolving the Empire.<ref name="TEGTW" /> During these events, the Jedi make significant efforts to purge the galaxy from darkness by systematically destroying the Sith texts and dangerous artifacts in order to prevent their use by power hungry dark siders.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" /><ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

In [[4400 BBY]], the ambitious Padawan [[Freedon Nadd]] was denied Knighthood by his Jedi Masters in order to test his humility. In an attempt to find out the reason of the decision, Nadd went to Jedi Master [[Matta Tremayne]], who in order to test his patience, ignored him, and when the angered Nadd decided to leave, told him that there are things they cannot simply teach him. When Nadd accused her of keeping secrets from him and proclaimed himself as a Jedi, Tremayne challenged him to a duel to prove to her that he was indeed a Jedi Knight. Not realizing it was another test, Nadd saw this as a threat and decided to attack and kill Tremayne, when she purposefully let her blade down. Blaming the Jedi Masters for murdering his teacher, the furious Nadd went looking for the Sith, because he felt that they were the only ones who would readily accept his apprenticeship and teach him about the Force.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" /> During his travels, Nadd discovered the Sith Lord Naga Sadow who was serving out his exile on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Awakening from his status chamber, Sadow trained Freedon Nadd in the ways of the dark side only to be killed by Nadd when his training was complete. Following Sadow's death, Nadd abandoned Yavin 4 in favor of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], located outside Republic space, with hopes of rebuilding a stronger Sith Empire. After Freedon Nadd had made himself the leader of the capital city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the Sith Lord began to exile those who questioned him; [[Beast Riders|some of whom]] managed to survive in the deadly jungles surrounding the city and organize into a tribe of hunter-gatherers. The world of Onderon suffered through the legacy of Nadd even after his death as a cult devoted to his memory, known as the [[Naddist]]s, [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|wreaked havoc]] on the people of the planet. When Jedi Master [[Arca Jeth]] attempted to move Freedon Nadd's remains to Onderon's moon [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] the Naddists, led by Onderonian [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]], attacked and managed to capture Nadd's remains as well as Jeth himself. Ommin then fled to the city of Iziz. The [[Republic Army|Republic's army]] converged on the planet and attacked Iziz, but was too strong and devastated the city. After the battle, Freedon Nadd's remains were taken to Dxun and sealed in an armored tomb.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

In [[4250 BBY]] the Jedi experienced a [[third Great Schism]] on Coruscant following Nadd's death, when a group of Jedi fell to the dark side and waged war against the Order. After a brief civil war on Coruscant, the Jedi forced the surviving group of dark siders to retreat to the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]], where they discovered that the planets of the system were artificial. Intending to unleash as much destruction as possible, the Dark Jedi tried to use the machines, but could not control the huge [[Cosmic Turbine]] that powered the system and quickly [[Vultar Cataclysm|annihilated]] themselves and the entire system.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /><ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===The Old Sith Wars===
{{Main|Old Sith Wars}}
====The Great Sith War====
{{Main|Great Sith War/Legends}}
{{Quote|Exar was a Jedi who was corrupted by ghosts of the old Sith, or so they say. He attempted to conquer the Republic and create a new Golden Age of the Sith.|[[Jolee Bindo]]|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Nomi_JATM.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Nomi Sunrider]], Jedi Knight of the Old Republic.]]
Over the generations, Ossus had continued to thrive as a Jedi fortress world, holding many treasures and knowledge in Odan-Urr's massive archives known as the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]]. The Jedi High Council began to take a more active role in the operations of the Order, and [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]] oversaw the construction of a massive [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]] on Coruscant to house members of the Order responsible for working directly with Republic representatives. In [[3997 BBY]], the talented and curious Jedi [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], having learned about the [[Golden Age of the Sith]], traveled from [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to Dxun where he found the tomb of Freedon Nadd. The spirit of Nadd corrupted Kun and the young Jedi surrendered to the dark side of the Force. After first traveling to Korriban, Kun then went to [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin's]] fourth moon and took over Naga Sadow's ancient fortresses, enslaving the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] race to further his ambitious plans. Destroying Nadd's spirit for the last time, Exar Kun staked his claim as the true heir to the ancient Sith legacy, which was thought to have been destroyed. When word of this unsettling turn of events reached the Jedi High Council, a [[Conclave at Deneba|conclave]] was called on [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]] to discuss the growing foothold of the Sith. During the conclave, the secret dark side society called the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] attacked the Jedi with [[Krath war droid/Legends|war droids]]. Led by [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]], the Krath were able to kill the legendary Master Arca Jeth, who died while saving his student [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma's]] life. When the Krath were repelled, the Jedi regrouped and returned to Ossus.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

Seeking retribution for his masters death Qel'Droma planned an unsanctioned mission to infiltrate the Krath in an attempt to destroy them from within. The Krath, suspecting he was a spy, injected him with a Sith poison and eventually Qel'Droma fell to the dark side and became a Krath general. Concurrently Sith acolyte Exar Kun traveled to [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] to find and destroy Ulic Qel-Droma. However, their duel was interrupted by the spirit of [[Marka Ragnos]], who commanded them to stop fighting each other and form an alliance, declaring them [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]]. United, the Dark Lords waged [[Great Sith War/Legends|war]] on the Republic, luring young Jedi from [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and subverting them to the dark side while in a stunning move, Exar Kun raided the Great Jedi Library and stole the [[Dark Holocron]] after murdering the legendary Master Odan-Urr. Elsewhere, Qel-Droma defeated [[Mandalore the Indomitable]], the leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and with their leader defeated the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] agreed to join the Sith.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

[[File:TotJTSW3-Textless-EC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Dark Lord of the Sith [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].]]
Qel-Droma's Krath and Mandalorian forces [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|laid siege]] to Coruscant in an all out attack at the heart of the Republic. Jedi forces on the capital were few as their temple remained as just a small hermitage but infighting between Qel-Droma and Aleema Keto allowed for the Republic to score a victory through the capture of Qel-Droma and the retreat of his forces. In the custody of the Republic, Qel-Droma was [[Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma|tried]] before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on Coruscant for war crimes. During the hearing, Dark Lord Exar Kun walked into the [[Senate Hall]] and executed the [[Sidrona|Chancellor]] before a shocked audience and later struck down the wise Master [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]]. Freeing Qel-Droma, Kun contacted his acolytes within the Jedi Order to assassinate their former Masters in a successful [[Sith uprising|uprising]] which left many Jedi dead. At the culmination of their attack on the Order, the Sith Lords made the suns of the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] go supernova using Naga Sadow's Sith flagship, which they had discovered on Yavin 4; the exploding stars sent a devastating shock wave through space directly towards Ossus. Aware of their impending doom, the Jedi desperately tried to save as many of the artifacts stored on the world while a mass evacuation took place. In a stunning move, Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma arrived on Ossus as the Jedi scattered in an effort to loot the Great Jedi Library. In the upper levels, Master [[Ood Bnar]] buried several priceless artifacts just before the Sith arrived. As the Sith attempted to strike him down, Bnar called on the Force to transform his body into that of a tree, a technique which came natural to the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]]. Meanwhile Qel-Droma dueled his brother [[Cay Qel-Droma|Cay]] and killed him in his anger. When confronted with the finality of his actions, Qel-Droma's will was shattered and was then cut off from the Force by the Jedi [[Nomi Sunrider]]. A broken shell, Qel-Droma surrendered to the Republic and was escorted off of Ossus as it was swept clean by the supernova's shock wave.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

With Qel-Droma in the hands of the Jedi Order, Exar Kun knew that his secret forces on Yavin 4 were in peril. To prevent his ultimate defeat, Kun committed a ritual which took the life from every Massassi on the planet to separate his spirit from his body and bind it to his [[Great Temple/Legends|temple]]. When Jedi forces arrived on the planet they unleashed a Force-assault on the world, trapping Kun's spirit within his temple indefinitely. With both Sith Lords defeated and the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] defeated on Onderon, the Jedi Order had finally brought an end to the Great Sith War. With many great Masters dead and the fortress world of Ossus uninhabitable, Master Nomi Sunrider called a [[Conclave on Exis Station|conclave]] on [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]] to formally address the Order and begin the healing process. With the entire Order in attendance, Sunrider accepted the leadership role within the Order and set to rebuild the High Council.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> Additionally, the headquarters of the Jedi was to be relocated to Coruscant, with major expansions on the existing enclave there to accommodate the entire Order. Relics and texts which had been stored at Exis Station after the destruction of Ossus would be transported to Coruscant as a new [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] was compiled within the Temple.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> In addition to her work in rebuilding the Order, Master Sunrider ordered the creation of an [[Lost City of the Jedi|underground city]] on the planet Yavin 4 to aide the recovery of the planet's ecology as well as to ensure that Kun's spirit never returned again.<ref name="KOTORCG" />

====The Mandalorian Wars====
{{Main|Mandalorian Wars}}
{{Quote|It was not your ships or your men or your vaunted 'fight for freedom' that won this, the final battle of the war. It was by the actions of one person–the Jedi Revan–that you prevailed. His strategies and tactics defeated the best of us. Even Mandalore himself was taken aback by the ferocity of his attacks, the tenacity of his defenses, and the subtleties of his plans.|[[Canderous Ordo]]|audio=CanderousonRevan.flac|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:SWKOTOR7-FC.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the Mandalorian Wars.]]

As the Order settled in on Coruscant, the renowned [[Jedi Seer]] [[Krynda Draay]] saw it as her duty to prevent another war like the one that had just plagued the galaxy and taken so many lives, including that of her husband, [[Barrison Draay]]. Resigning from the Order and holing herself away within her late husband's massive [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] [[Draay Estate|Estate]], Draay began the lengthy process of training an army of Seers without the knowledge of the High Council. As the Order grew complacent in the eyes of Draay, the respected Master created the [[Jedi Covenant|Covenant]], a shadowy organization devoted to spotting and dealing with any [[Shatterpoint/Legends|shatterpoints]] that could cause the Sith to emerge again. With her own son, [[Lucien Draay]], as head of the [[First WatchCircle]], Draay and her faithful retainer [[Haazen]] guided their movements on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as they sought a dangerous weapon of the Sith called the [[Muur Talisman]].<ref name="KotorC" />

The events of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] would begin the decline of the Jedi Order. They coincided with a vision seen by four Jedi Masters—the Consular members of the First WatchCircle of the Draay's Covenant—who saw visions of chaos in the Jedi Order and the Republic as well as signs that the responsible party could be one of their Padawans. The Masters decided to strike, but only succeeded in [[Padawan Massacre|murdering four of their own Padawans]] who were near Knighthood. Their actions also caused massive civil disorder on Taris—which later made the planet easy prey for the Mandalorians—alienated Padawan [[Zayne Carrick]] from the Order, and inadvertently dissolved even their own group, being split up by the High Council and assigned to different postings around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As each of the WatchCircle members began to die through mysterious circumstance which resembled their vision of impending doom, one of their number, Master [[Xamar]], revealed the truth of the Covenant to the High Council and confessed his crime. As the High Council moved to secure the Draay Estate, it became clear that the venerated Master Krynda Draay was no longer in command; Haazen, her retainer and secret [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], had taken over and descended into madness. Sending members of the Covenant against the Jedi Temple and hijacking ships from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], Haazen ultimately and inadvertently destroyed the estate and himself through an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].<ref name="KotorC" />

The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], led by [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], began to conquer planets that were left defenseless after the Sith War. By adding the weapons and technology of their victims to their own the Mandalorians soon built a large army, and their territory grew fast. The Republic's efforts to stop the Mandalorians were ineffective, and soon Mandalore took advantage of this weakness by directly attacking Republic space. The Jedi High Council refused to help the Republic, believing that caution was necessary and unwilling to bloody their hands after their heavy losses after last war. However, during this time, the Jedi Council did not hold total control over the Jedi. Jedi Enclaves and training facilities were scattered throughout the galaxy, with many masters and mentors teaching their own versions of Jedi ideals and methodologies. Rivalries extended so far as to foster the formation of secret Jedi groups and covenants that operated independently, either on their own initiative or influenced by members of the Jedi Order and Jedi Council. Such infighting among the Jedi further disrupted the order during the Mandalorian invasions. The Council's decision set poorly with many young Jedi who, under the leadership of Jedi Knight [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his friend [[Darth Malak|Alek]], openly defied the Council and leading the Republic's forces in battle. Revan used Mandalorian tactics against his enemies: he was willing to sacrifice one planet if it meant securing victory at a more important one.<ref name="KotorC" /> Under the leadership of Revan and Alek the Republic liberated many planets, and the final battle of the war was fought at [[Malachor V]].<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref><ref name="Core Rulebook" />

During the [[Battle of Malachor V|battle]], Revan killed Mandalore in hand-to-hand combat and obliterated the remaining Mandalorian forces. The war with the Mandalorians was over. The Mandalorians had been defeated by a worthy opponent, and destroyed their armor and weapons as a sign of respect.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> While the Republic hailed Revan and Alek, who went by the name Malak, as heroes the High Council was deeply enraged. Ordering all so called [[Revanchist]]s back to the Coruscant Temple for judgment, the High Council's summons were only respected by General [[Meetra Surik]]. Appearing before the Council to await judgment, the Council stripped Surik of her titles and banished her for her role in the destruction of Malachor V. In addition, Jedi Master [[Kreia]], Revan's former mentor, was exiled as the Council felt her '[[Gray Jedi|gray]]' stance on the Force had led her students, most notably Revan, down the path of the dark side.<ref name="KOTORII" />

====The Jedi Civil War====
{{Main|Jedi Civil War}}
{{Quote|The reason the Jedi Civil War was named such was because few in the galaxy can recognize the difference between the Sith and the Jedi. To them, they are both Jedi&mdash;with different philosophies.|[[Mical]]|<ref name="KOTORII" />}}
At the close of the Mandalorian Wars, the Jedi Revan and Malak mysteriously disappeared into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], supposedly pursuing the last remnants of the Mandalorian fleet.<ref name="KOTOR" /> Unknown to the Order or the High Council, the two Jedi had traced clues to the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where they discovered that the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] lived on in secret and was ruled by the mysterious and incredibly powerful [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Driven by haste and curiosity, Raven and Malak confronted the Emperor without alerting the Republic. Unable to stop him, the Emperor corrupted the Jedi and sent them back to the Republic as the Sith Lords [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> Returning to the Republic with their loyal followers in tow, the newly christened Sith Lords began to wage a second war, preying on a Republic already weakened by the Mandalorians and taking full advantage of the immense number of Jedi who were still willing to follow the pair.<ref name="KOTOR" />

[[File:DarthRevan_DarthMalak_EGF.png|thumb|left|200px|The Dark Lords of the Sith, Malak and Revan.]]
This [[Jedi Civil War]] pitted masters against students, fathers against sons, and friends against best friends, making it one of the most emotionally powerful wars in galactic history. While the early stages of the war were indecisive, it soon became apparent that [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Revan's Sith armada]] was growing at a steady rate, and in a short time the Republic was overwhelmed with the seemingly limitless forces of the enemy. World after world fell to Revan's vast fleets and masterful strategies. Determined not to make the same mistakes they had in the Mandalorian Wars, the High Council devised a plan to eliminate the enemy at its source: Revan. During one fateful battle a small Jedi strike team led by [[Bastila Shan]], a young Jedi Padawan with the remarkable gift of [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]], infiltrated Darth Revan's command ship to capture the Dark Lord. During the confrontation, Darth Malak, who was stationed aboard a different ship, realized that Revan could be easily defeated and that he could then assume the title of Dark Lord of the Sith, fired upon his own master's vessel in the hope of killing both Revan and the Jedi fighting him. The Jedi managed to escape with the injured Revan's body, but Malak had achieved a crucial victory, for he was now the Dark Lord of the Sith and commander of the entire Sith armada.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Malak continued to wage war against the Republic, relying exclusively on brute force as opposed to subtle strategies. Following the Sith tradition, he took an apprentice of his own: former Jedi [[Darth Bandon]]. As the situation for the Republic and the Jedi became more desperate, they began to rely more and more on the battle meditation of Bastila Shan to gain an advantage over the ever-growing Sith Empire. Consequently, Darth Malak began to target Shan specifically, hoping to crush the Republic's last chance of standing against his armies. During one battle in orbit above the world of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Shan's vessel, the [[Endar Spire]], was crippled beyond recovery, and the young Jedi was forced to evacuate to the planet below. As fate would have it, two other survivors eventually caught up with Shan on Taris: [[Carth Onasi]], a decorated soldier and war hero of the Republic, and another lowly officer who Shan recently had transferred to her command. The key to the rest of the war, however, lay in the identity of this single, seemingly insignificant foot soldier.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Onasi and Shan continued to gain more companions, managed to escape the [[destruction of Taris]], and fled to Dantooine's [[Jedi Enclave|secret Jedi Enclave]], where their third companion was inducted into the Order and they discovered the existence of the [[Star Forge]]. The Jedi Council commissioned their small band to seek out [[Star Map]]s from various planets in order to discover the location of the Star Forge, which they believed was the key to Malak's power. During their quest, the group encountered and defeated many Sith minions, including Darth Bandon. The biggest interruption to their mission was the groups capture by one of the Sith fleet's command ships. After a frantic escape attempt, Onasi, Shan, and the new Jedi Padawan encountered Darth Malak himself. This confrontation revealed a startling truth: that Darth Revan had not been killed, but had instead been rendered [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] by Malak's attack and saved by the Jedi, specifically Shan. The Jedi Council had inserted over his destroyed mind a new identity, that of a lowly officer who was now a Jedi Padawan. Darth Revan had been traveling with Shan and Onasi the entire time.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Upon escaping Malak and realizing his true identity, Revan was determined to complete his mission and destroy his old apprentice. Eventually, he and his companions discovered the location of the Star Forge and launched an attack in collaboration with the Republic against it. Revan managed to infiltrate the giant factory, which was the source of the Sith's limitless armada, and [[Battle of Rakata Prime|defeated]] his old apprentice Malak once and for all. Despite the victory over Malak and the apparent defeat of the Sith, the High Council and the Order in general kept Revan and his wife, Bastila Shan, at a distance. Regarded as outsiders, Revan and Shan remained outside of the walls of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant while an increasingly strained relationship with the Order wore on them. Revan, suffering from crippling Force visions, eventually left for the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] in search of answers.<ref name="KOTORII" />

====First Jedi Purge and aftermath====
The Jedi Civil War took a huge toll on the Jedi and the Republic, leaving them incredibly vulnerable to attack. In the wake of the war, the High Council called a [[Conclave at Katarr|conclave]] on the planet [[Katarr/Legends|Katarr]] to regroup and refocus the Order. It was at this conclave that [[Darth Nihilus]], a member of the [[Sith Triumvirate]], attacked the world and wiped all life from the planet's surface. The attack on the conclave would see the near-destruction and death of the Order, with all but a hundred individual Jedi surviving throughout the galaxy. Immediately after, Triumvir [[Darth Sion]] committed his legions of [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] to hunting down the surviving Jedi in the [[first Jedi Purge]]. Realizing that the threat was greater when Jedi gathered in numbers, the surviving members of the High Council disbanded the Order, with the remaining Jedi Masters going into hiding on planets across the galaxy in the hopes that this would allow them to discover the true origins of the new Sith threat without endangering everyone around them. The [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was completely abandoned, and the badly damaged [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] was left nothing but a hollow shell.<ref name="KOTORII" />

A former Jedi, [[Meetra Surik]], also known as the Jedi Exile who had been cut off from the Force and exiled by the High Council years earlier, sought out the remaining Councilors who were in hiding, in an attempt to form a group to defeat the threat of the Sith Triumvirate, who were threatening to annihilate the Jedi completely. As she traveled the galaxy in search of the hidden Jedi, Surik trained several of her companions in the ways of the Force. She found [[Vrook Lamar]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Zez-Kai Ell]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and [[Kavar]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The three former Councilors then met with Surik once again in the rebuilt [[Jedi Enclave]] on Dantooine. They decided to once again exile her, as well as sever her completely from the Force, as they felt she was a threat to all living beings around her. As they attempted to carry out their plan, Kreia, Surik's mentor, killed them, and after revealing herself as the third Sith Lord, Darth Traya, she left Surik on Dantooine. Surik's revival corresponded with the Sith attack on the Republic, and she traveled to [[Telos IV]] to fight the Sith Lord [[Darth Nihilus]]. Surik defeated Nihilus on his flagship above Telos, before traveling to [[Malachor V]] to kill Darths Traya and Sion, the two remaining Sith Lords.<ref name="KOTORII" />

[[File:Jedi_Order_JMGD.jpg|thumb|250px|Jedi Order in the period between The First Jedi Purge and Great Galactic War]]
Eventually, the group of individuals Surik trained, known as the [[Lost Jedi]], would, as Darth Traya prophesied, come together to re-establish another Jedi Order. As the Order was slowly reformed, Surik was able to convince Masters Shan and [[Atris]] to return to Coruscant and the abandoned Jedi Temple there and slowly rebuild. Training a new generation of Jedi, Surik reestablished the High Council with the assistance of her companions from the war and the Order and the Galactic Republic began the long, slow process of rebuilding. Within time, Surik saw the Jedi Order flourish once more, but was haunted by reoccurring dreams and a beckoning from beyond known space. Leaving the Republic and the Order behind, Surik departed Coruscant to search for Master Revan and the darkness he had sought to find beyond the galactic rim.<ref name="KOTORII" />

===Resurgence of the Sith Empire===
{{Quote|Our time has come. For 300 years, we prepared. We grew stronger. While you rested in your cradle of power, believing your people were safe&hellip; protected. You were trusted to lead the Republic but you were deceived, as our powers over the dark side had blinded you. You assumed no force could challenge you and now&hellip; finally&hellip; we have returned.|Darth Malgus|audio=InvasionOfTheJediTemple.flac|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
====The Great Galactic War====
{{Main|Great Galactic War}}
{{Quote|The Great Galactic War dragged on for decades. Thousands of Jedi and Sith were slain. Countless star systems were ravaged.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|audio=GreatWarDraggedOn.flac|<ref name="Timeline1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref>}}
[[File:Great_War_Jedi_vs_Sith.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jedi engage Sith during the Great War.]]
The Republic and the Order had thought that the Sith Empire had been completely destroyed in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace War; unknown to them a single [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] managed to escape<ref name="Revan" /> Chancellor [[Pultimo]]'s attack on Korriban<ref name="TEA" /> and established himself as the new [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and continued the rule of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was this Emperor who had corrupted Revan and Malak, the same Emperor who would imprison Revan for a second time after his return to Dromund Kaas following the Jedi Civil War.<ref name="Revan" /> In [[3681 BBY]], the Sith Empire came out of hiding and attacked the Republic and the Jedi, taking both by complete surprise.<ref name="the republic">{{Holonet|allegiances|galactic-republic|The Galactic Republic}}</ref> Unknown to the Republic, the Sith had already infiltrated several planetary governments, the Republic and the Order itself, allowing it [[Tingel Arm campaign|several]] [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|victories]].<ref name="Timeline6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> As Jedi and Republic forces [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|fought]]<ref name="Timeline5">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref> back, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], under the leader ship of [[Mandalore the Lesser]],<ref name="Mandalore">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref> [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|entered the conflict]] on the side of the Empire.<ref name="Timeline3">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians|int=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians}}</ref> The war would eventually last 28 standard years. In [[3653 BBY]] with [[Alderaan peace conference|peace talks]] commencing on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the Sith launched a [[Sacking of Coruscant|surprise attack]] on Coruscant, devastating the planet, killing the Chancellor and nearly destroying the Jedi Temple. With Coruscant in their hands, the Sith presented the Republic with the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> The Treaty sued for peace but was heavily biased towards the Sith, demanding that the Republic turn over several long time territories<ref name="Timeline1" /> and Republic forces had to withdraw from current battlefields leaving the planets defenseless to Imperial occupation. With little choice, the Republic accepted ending the Great War.<ref name="ToPNGO">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 2: New Galactic Order]]''</ref>

====The Cold War====
{{Main|Cold War (Galactic Republic&ndash;Sith Empire)}}
[[File:Tython_rediscovery.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rediscovery of Tython by the Jedi Order]]
The Cold War officially was only border skirmishes between rogue elements of the Republic and Sith Empire, yet all across the galaxy both sides were supporting coups, revolutions, assassinations and even all out civil war. Without the Temple on Coruscant, the Order drifted homeless for a short period before Jedi Knight [[Satele Shan]] returned from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] with coordinates to the lost planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. As [[Jedi scout]]s prepared the planet for recolonization, the Order dealt with the loss of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Zym]] over the ruins of the Coruscant Temple and the defection of Master [[Dar'Nala]] to terrorism. As a new [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] emerged on Tython, the Jedi resettled their ancient homeworld and began to slowly rebuild. As Shan was appointed Grand Master, Jedi explored Tython forests and ruins, reconnecting with their roots and growing stronger in the Force. Elsewhere in the Republic, planets like [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] were major battlegrounds where both sides suffered from treaty-breaking, but unofficial backing; all across the galaxy the Great Galactic War was igniting a second time.<ref name="SWTOR" />

[[Hero of Tython|Several]] [[The Barsen'thor|new]] [[Voidhound|heroes]] [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|emerged]] [[Darth Nox|in]] [[Empire's Wrath|this]] [[Hunter (individual)|time]] [[Cipher Nine|period]]; these heroes were both of the Republic and the Sith Empire, and they grew more powerful and significant over time, eventually becoming the main fighters for their respective sides, as many significant ones fell in the Cold War. Members of the Jedi Order who remained on Coruscant made up a special Jedi delegation within the Senate, while others tried to protect the ruins of the Jedi Temple and protect any of its remaining treasures. The new heroes which emerged were believed to be the ones that would lead the Republic and Sith Empire to an [[Galactic War|all-out war]] that would be more devastating and dangerous than any other in the past.<ref name="SWTOR" />

====Galactic War====
{{Main|Galactic War}}
{{Quote|We are at war! The Dark Council has placed me in charge and battles are being waged across the galaxy.|[[Darth Baras]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
[[File:TOR_Corellia_attacked.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ravaged remains of Corellia, one of the planets attacked in the Second Great War.]]
The sham known as the Cold War came to an inevitable end and the [[Galactic War]] erupted on galactic scale, but was even more brutal than any other war in the past. The Jedi Order quickly mobilized to compete with the Sith Empire and various third parties, all of whom where at their peak and with many mighty heroes. Engaging each other in full-scale war once again, Sith and Republic forces clashed, while the constant specter of betrayal loomed over everyone. Yet despite the copious amounts of traitors and third parties, they did little to stop the Republic and Empire from continuing their war. The Great War saw some of the Republic and Empire's bravest and mightiest heroes emerge, and this only created more tension and alarm, adding to the chaos already generated by the Great War.<ref name="SWTOR" />

The immense clash would lead to the defeat of various third parties and their leaders, such as [[Darth Malgus]], leader of his own [[New Empire|rebellion]], and [[Bouris Ulgo]], leader of [[House Ulgo]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Dread Masters]] of the Sith Empire would be freed, and the destructive nature of this new war would radiate throughout the galaxy, slowly ravaging it. After a long, drawn out conflict, the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic proved victorious and the Sith Empire of old was finally defeated. The Jedi Order would return to Coruscant, abandoning Tython indefinitely, and rebuild the Jedi Temple slowly with financial aid from the recovering Republic. A new era of peace began, but was to be short lived.<ref name="SWTOR" />

===The New Sith Wars===
{{Main|New Sith Wars}}
[[File:Lord_Hoth_EGTTF.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Lord Hoth, leader of the Army of Light]]
The horrors of the Old Sith Wars and the near extinction of the Jedi Order that had resulted from the conflict were remembered in the Republic for generations. Few could have guessed, however, that a [[New Sith Wars|much larger conflict]] would soon engulf the galaxy. From within the Order's ranks Jedi Master [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Phanius]], one of the Order's brightest members, became entranced with the forbidden knowledge of the Sith and, defying the High Council, absconded into deep space with a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] stolen from the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. Phanius took up the long vacant title of Dark Lord of the Sith as well as a new name and identity: [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Darth Ruin]]. In the ensuing years, Ruin gathered together a large number of dark side followers and surviving Sith clans and founded the [[New Sith]] Empire. With this army Ruin planned to bring the Republic, and the Jedi who served it, to their knees. Beginning what would be a thousand year war, Ruin's empire quickly became fractured, tearing down the Republic and the Jedi Order while ravaging itself from the inside out. The Order was plagued by ineffectual leadership throughout the conflict, constantly held back by a politically-minded High Council. To counter the poor management of Order, several Jedi left Coruscant to establish baronies and kingdoms on the Rim, protecting their subjects while demanding fealty and military service. These so-called [[Jedi Lord]]s established a loose confederation under the guidance of a [[Jedi Grand Council]] made up of the most powerful Lords, waging wars against the Sith Empire and killing any Sith minions who intruded on Jedi space.<ref name="TEGTW" />

In [[1010 BBY]], the High Council raised their protege [[Skere Kaan]] to the rank of Master, dispatching him into the galaxy to cripple the Sith Empire; the High Council did this despite their knowledge of Kaan's extremist views and his belief that the Order and the Republic were responsible for the state of the galaxy. Taking with him a group of like-minded Jedi, Kaan declared himself Dark Lord and organized a [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], issuing a warning to all surviving Sith: join the Brotherhood and bend the knee or die. Holding true to his promise of death to all who did not join the Brotherhood, the High Council sent their congratulations to Kaan for his swift work of the worst of the Sith Lords. Kaan openly mocked the Order and the thanks, declaring war on them and promising to burn their Temple to the ground. Furious at the Council ineptitude, [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Lord Hoth]] rallied the banners of those loyal to him and raised a great host called the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. Gaining the support of the last Grand Council of the Jedi and every last lord, Hoth harried the Brotherhood along [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|its flank]] until the Army of Light had enough practice at warfare to strike at the Brotherhood's heart. Meeting the Brotherhood in open combat during a series of [[Ruusan campaign|campaigns]] at the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], the conflict ground on for seven fierce battles costing many lives on both sides. At the conclusion of the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|seventh battle]], Lord Kaan&mdash;near defeat and driven insane by the power of the dark side&mdash;unleashed the horrors of the [[thought bomb]] in a cave system, engulfing every single Force-user on the world.<ref name="TEGTW" />

The New Sith Wars were over. The Jedi Order had survived once again despite the deaths of nearly every member of the Army of Light on Ruusan, and the Sith were presumed wiped out to the last individual. One, however, had survived: [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. He and his successors would hide from the Republic and the Jedi, planning revenge in utter secrecy under the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]..<ref name="DB:POD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

===Ruusan Reformation===
With the Sith presumed extinct, the Jedi believed that they had at last forged a long-lasting peace in the galaxy. With the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] passing the Senate and receiving the High Council's blessings, both the Jedi Order and the Republic renounced militarism, disbanding their vast armies and navies. From that point on, the galaxy would rely on smaller [[Planetary Security Forces]] and the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] to help the Jedi keep the peace.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

The wave of change sweeping the Republic enabled forward-thinking Jedi to make vast strides in the Order' setup during the first years of peace. Under the leadership of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Fae Coven]], the Jedi High Council became more influential, and many loose rules were codified. Adults were banned from entering into the Order after Ruusan proved them to be too volatile and susceptible to the dark side's sway. They would renounce all ties to the outside world&mdash;to wealth, material possessions, and even family. Training would now be undertaken on a strict one-to-one basis and centralized on Coruscant. With the far-flung academies of the past, the temptation of delving into forbidden knowledge was considered too great for members of the order. Many far-flung, satellite training facilities were closed and the Temple on Coruscant became the heart of the Order. The [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] were firmly put in place to ensure all Knights were tested on a fair and equal scale. Coven was also ensured that her changes would be known by every Jedi by drafting and putting into circulation throughout the Order personal copies of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', a guidebook given to each and every member of the Order.<ref name="TJP" />

Along with Master Coven's quest to set the Order on a firm footing, [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker of First Knowledge]] [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]] and the other members of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] were determined to completely eradicate all memory of the Sith to ensure they never returned. Dispatching [[Jedi Shadow|Shadows]] to find and locate all Sith artifacts, relics, and even history books detailing past Jedi-Sith conflicts; the Order essentially erased all memory of the Sith in under five decades.<ref name="TJP" />

====The Sith return====
{{Quote|At last we will reveal ourselves to the Jedi. At last we will have revenge.|Darth Maul|audio=RevengeAtLast-TPM.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:SenatorPalpatine-TPM.png|thumb|left|200px|Senator Palpatine of Naboo]]
Over the ensuing millennium, the Jedi Order enjoyed a Golden Age in which training flourished and the Galactic Republic enjoyed peace. Following the disaster on [[Almas]] involving fallen Padawan [[Kibh Jeen]], the Order was made aware that a Sith had survived Ruusan and a new Rule of Two had been established. Believing the Sith to be a minor threat, it wasn't until the machinations of [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] and his apprentice [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] in the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]] circa [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], that the Jedi Order felt the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the first time in nearly one thousand years.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the presence of the Sith once again became clear by the Jedi. The Sith Lord [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who was being trained by Plagueis, had secretly contacted members of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], including [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]], and saw to it that Gunray was made [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of the Federation by using a special [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]], in conjunction with the Federation Ruling Council's battle droids, to kill the members of the Ruling Council. Along with a series of other devious plots, Sidious was responsible for manipulating Gunray to show the Republic that they could not bully him with trade embargoes by [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] the remote planet of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Supreme Chancellor dispatched Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to negotiate a Trade Federation withdrawal.<ref name="TPM" />

However, the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] attempted to [[Mission to Naboo|murder]] the Jedi, and so the pair was forced to hide on an invasion craft which carried them down to the planet. There Jinn met and rescued a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] by the name of [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. Binks led Jinn and Kenobi to the Gungan city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. The [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]], while rather difficult at first, at last allowed Jedi to take a [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|bongo]] to the capital city of Naboo, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. There the Jedi rescued [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from a droid escort. The group then fled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where they repaired the Queen's ship, and from there to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When Amidala realized that the Senate could not solve her problem, she returned to Naboo. There, with the help of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] and a young boy named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the Queen and her Jedi protectors defeated the Federation's [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]]; however, in a climactic lightsaber duel between Jinn, Kenobi, and Sidious's apprentice, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], Jinn was killed. Stung by his master's death, Kenobi threw himself at the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], seemingly killing him. After Darth Maul was defeated, the Jedi knew that there was still at least one member of the Sith active, but they were unaware of the identity of Sidious, who around the same time, had betrayed and murdered Plagueis to become the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="TPM" />

====The Clone Wars====
{{Main|Clone Wars/Legends}}
{{Quote|Victory? Victory, you say? Master Obi-Wan, not victory. The shroud of the dark side has fallen. Begun, the Clone War has.|Master Yoda after the Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|ten years]] following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Jedi Master [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Count/Legends|Count]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], left the Jedi Order and became the leader of a group of corporations, such as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, unknown to the Jedi, Dooku had been recruited by Darth Sidious and had become his apprentice, renamed [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]].<ref name="AOTC" />

[[File:TCW_Jedi.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jedi during the Clone Wars.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], a young [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], were captured by Dooku on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The trio were scheduled for execution; however, they were saved when a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|group]] of over two hundred Jedi arrived, led by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. In the [[Petranaki arena]] most of the Jedi perished, and the few remaining formed a circle in the center of the arena, surrounded by hundreds of Confederacy droids. However, before they could be killed, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived with thousands of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],<ref name="AOTC" /> who had secretly been ordered by Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]].<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> The clones rescued the remaining Jedi, and so the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and thus the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], began. The Jedi attempted to stop Count Dooku from leaving Geonosis. Obi-Wan Kenobi was injured in a duel with Dooku, and Kenobi's apprentice, Anakin Skywalker, lost his arm. Master Yoda led the clones and the Jedi to victory, and when the battle was all but won he traveled to meet Dooku. After a short duel with Dooku, Yoda was forced to let the Separatist leader escape in order to save Kenobi and Skywalker. Of the hundreds of Jedi in the rescue team, less than fifty survived the opening salvo of the war.<ref name="AOTC" />

The Clone Wars escalated into one of the largest wars in galactic history in a matter of weeks. The members of the Jedi Order played a pivotal part in the war, acting as [[Jedi General/Legends|generals]] to the vast [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]; an act which troubled the Order and caused the deaths of thousands of Jedi during the war.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> This change created other shifts within the Jedi Order as well. While some viewed the Clone Wars as opportunity to help save the Republic from destruction, others saw their involvement in the war as a perversion of their basic beliefs. Some members splintered away to from their own groups that maintained their ideals without compromise. Still others felt that the Jedi Order approached the war from wrong direction, leading them to create their own factions that fought the war as they saw fit.<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The [[Jedi Schism]] also threatened the unity of the Order, as some Jedi did not want to fight.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> Those Jedi who accepted their new responsibilities faced considerable challenges. Some struggled with the ethical implications of leading clone soldiers bred for war, while others witnessed Padawans and younger Jedi Knights grappling with impatience and strong emotions, burning with a desire for revenge against the Separatists and their leaders.<ref name="TEGTW" /> To combat the Force abilities of the Jedi, Dooku enlisted the help of several Dark Jedi, as well as [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] bounty hunter [[Durge/Legends|Durge]]. Dooku had many [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Force-using subordinates]], though the most feared of them were [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]],<ref name="JMW">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref> [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]],<ref name="J:AS">''[[Jedi: Aayla Secura]]''</ref> [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], as well as [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], who served as a double-agent.<ref name="SW:R">''[[Star Wars: Republic]]''</ref> 

Four months after Geonosis, the Jedi Order faced their biggest threat in the war against the Confederacy: General Grievous. On [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], Grievous was revealed to the Republic and the Order as a killing machine, slaying several Jedi and wounding several other high ranking members of the Order.<ref name="Clone Wars">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''</ref> On [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], the Jedi suffered heavy losses, and although they managed to evacuate the planet, all except one of the [[Padawan Pack]], a group of Padawans orphaned when their Masters either were killed or disappeared, perished. The sole survivor was Anakin Skywalker, who was slowly becoming more famous.<ref name="SWR:TBOJ">''[[Star Wars: Republic: The Battle of Jabiim]]''</ref> 

The Clone Wars were a period of decline for the Jedi Order. In the years leading up to and during the conflict, the Order’s numbers decreased, as many Jedi Generals were killed in skirmishes on distant battlefields. Even before the end of the war, many Jedi sensed that their organization was in decline.<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" />

This affected not only the Jedi themselves but also those who relied on them. With the Jedi drawn into the Clone Wars, planets that depended on them to settle disputes and protect them from predatory neighbors were left exposed to danger and unrest.<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" />

Towards the end of the war, the Separatists retreated from many of their bases in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], to [[Fortress world/Legends|Fortress worlds]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and Outer Rim, after being defeated by the Republic in a series of battles. This boosted the morale of the Republic, and Chancellor Palpatine and the Jedi deployed almost every fleet available to CIS worlds in the Outer Rim, laying siege to the Separatist strongholds in an attempt to force the Confederacy to surrender; however, the Sieges left many senior Jedi dead.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> On [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], the Order lost several members but were able to remove Asajj Ventress from the war while<ref name="Star Wars: Obsession">''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]''</ref> Sora Bulq and his [[Morgukai Shadow Army]] were defeated on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref> The citizens of the Core were led to believe that the end of the war was near, and that the Confederacy would be brought to justice in the near future. In truth, the Sieges were the work of Darth Sidious, intended to lure forces away from Coruscant<ref name="LoE" />

[[File:Spacebattle.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Battle of Coruscant.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], with most of the Republic's army and the Jedi fighting in the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], the Separatist fleet, led by Grievous and Dooku, launched a week-long siege against Coruscant.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> Thousands of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|Droid tri-fighters]] rained down on the capital, and Confederacy [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] unleashed hundreds of millions of battle droids and tank droids on the capital's streets, causing much damage to lives and property. In response, the Republic deployed its clone forces against the CIS droids.
